$comment: Files in web2 taken from or modelled on T3 Code (MIT, THIRD_PARTY.md). mode: verbatim = byte-identical to upstream at commit; adapted = upstream body with local edits (header names the source); pattern = same job and name, Sightr's own code; shape = mirrors type and field names only (contracts outside web2/; local paths stay relative to web2/). decisions = upstream changes chosen not to take ({upstream, commit, verdict: skip | defer, reason, date}); the checker hides one until that file changes upstream again. Check for upstream changes with `bun scripts/t3-upstream.ts`; porting a change bumps the row's commit.
